<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Hazina.AgentFactory</id>
    <version>2.5.0</version>
    <authors>Prospergenics</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/prospergenics/devgpt</projectUrl>
    <description>High-level agent factory for building autonomous AI agents in Hazina. Provides configuration parsing, built-in tool collections (file ops, git, dotnet, npm, BigQuery, email, WordPress), and multi-agent flow orchestration. Simplifies creating production-ready AI agents.</description>
    <copyright>Copyright © 2025 Hazina Project</copyright>
    <tags>ai-agents agent-factory orchestration tools bigquery email wordpress git automation</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/prospergenics/devgpt" commit="7ad3e04b80287718d5b68ac76839605049d7cdb9" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="Hazina.Generator" version="2.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hazina.LLMs.OpenAI" version="2.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hazina.LLMs.SemanticKernel" version="2.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hazina.LLMs.Classes" version="2.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hazina.LLMs.Client" version="2.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hazina.LLMs.Helpers" version="2.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hazina.Store.DocumentStore" version="2.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hazina.Store.EmbeddingStore" version="2.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Google.Cloud.BigQuery.V2" version="3.11.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="MailKit" version="4.13.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
